## Problem

Predict the review score (ordinal target, 1 to 5 stars) from text written by customers of a Brazilian e-commerce, and understand what drives the most severe complaints.

## Approach

Classical approach (TF-IDF with Logistic Regression, SVM and LightGBM) compared with fine-tuning a Portuguese transformer (BERTimbau), plus topic extraction from complaints.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag} [LightGBM]{.tag} [Transformers]{.tag} [BERTimbau]{.tag}
